title: Browse products and open a product details page
description: Verifies a shopper can browse the products list and open a product detail page from the listing.

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product grid
Verify element "Add to cart" is visible

title: Filter products by category
description: Verifies selecting a category filter updates the visible product list.

title: Filter products by color
description: Verifies selecting a color filter updates the visible product list.

title: Filter products by size
description: Verifies selecting a size filter updates the visible product list.

title: Sort products by price
description: Verifies sorting by price updates the ordering shown on the products listing.

steps.description: Select "Price: Low to High" from dropdown "Sort"
Verify text "Price: Low to High" is visible

title: Search for a product with a common query and open a result
description: Verifies search returns results and a user can open a product details page from the results.

steps.description: Click on the first product in the product grid

title: Search with no matching results shows a no-results message
description: Verifies an unmatched search shows a visible no-results state to the user.

title: Clear or broaden filters after no-results to restore visible products
description: Verifies a shopper can recover from a no-results state by clearing/broadening filters and see products again.

title: Navigate pagination to view additional products
description: Verifies pagination controls allow moving to the next page of product results.

title: Add an in-stock variant to cart from Product Details and open cart
description: Verifies a shopper can select a product variant, add it to the cart, see confirmation feedback, and reach the cart page.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Verify element "Product images gallery" is visible
Select an available option in the color variant selector
Select an available option in the size variant selector
Verify text "added to cart" is visible

title: Cart reflects item after adding from Product Details
description: Verifies the cart page shows the newly added product line item after adding from Product Details.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Select an available option in the color variant selector
Select an available option in the size variant selector
Verify text "added to cart" is visible
Click on the cart icon or "Cart" link in the header

title: Prevent adding to cart when required variant selections are missing
description: Verifies the user is prompted to select required variant options before adding to cart.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Verify text "Add to cart" is visible
Verify element "Cart" is not updated on the page (no added-to-cart confirmation is visible)

title: Out-of-stock variant shows message and blocks Add to cart
description: Verifies selecting an out-of-stock variant shows an out-of-stock state and prevents adding to cart.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Select an option in a variant selector that is labeled as out of stock
Verify text "Out of stock" is visible
Verify text "Add to cart" is visible
Verify text "added to cart" is not visible

title: Product media gallery interaction updates the main image
description: Verifies the product image gallery can be used to view different product images.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Verify element "Product images gallery" is visible
Click on a different thumbnail image in the gallery
Verify element "Main product image" is visible
Click on another thumbnail image in the gallery
Verify element "Main product image" is visible

title: Add product to wishlist from Product Details (guest)
description: Verifies a guest user can use the wishlist action from Product Details and sees visible confirmation feedback.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Click on "Wishlist" in the header or navigation

title: View product reviews section on Product Details
description: Verifies the reviews section is visible and can be opened/read on the Product Details page.

steps.description: Click on the first product item in the products list
Verify element "Product reviews list" is visible

title: Breadcrumb navigation returns to Products listing from Product Details
description: Verifies breadcrumbs on Product Details navigate back to a parent listing page.

description: Verifies that the cart page loads and displays cart items along with a visible subtotal section.

steps.description: Verify an element "Cart item" is visible
Verify an element "Proceed to checkout" is visible

title: Update item quantity and see subtotal update
description: Verifies that changing an item quantity updates the cart subtotal accordingly.

description: Verifies that removing a cart item updates the visible cart item list.

steps.description: Verify an element "Cart item" is visible

title: Select a shipping zone in cart sidebar
description: Verifies that the user can select a shipping zone and the selection is reflected on the page.

title: Proceed to checkout from cart
description: Verifies that clicking Proceed to checkout initiates the checkout transition from the cart page.

steps.description: Verify element "Proceed to checkout" is visible

title: Continue shopping from cart returns to products listing
description: Verifies that Continue shopping navigates the user away from the cart to continue browsing products.

steps.description: Verify an element "Cart item" is visible
Update item quantity above available stock
Verify element "Proceed to checkout" is visible

title: Add a product to wishlist when authenticated and verify it appears in wishlist

Click on the first product in the products list
Click on "Add to wishlist" on the product page
Verify text "Added to wishlist" is visible
Click on "Wishlist" in the site navigation
Verify element "Wishlist items list" is visible

title: View profile information on the protected Profile page
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access /profile and see their profile information.

steps.description: Fill "Updated Test Name" into the name input field
Fill "updated.email+test@example.com" into the email input field

steps.description: Fill "not-an-email" into the email input field

title: Admin dashboard loads and shows key statistics cards
